A Letter For You 💌

My dearest Anju ❤️,

Happy one month anniversary, Kattan. 🥹❤️

Honestly, it feels both surprising and beautiful that one whole month has already passed. But when I look back at all the moments we've spent together, every conversation, every smile, every little moment feels special to me.

There are so many things I love about you, but your charming smile will always have a special place in my heart. The way you love me, the way you care, and especially the way you are when you're around me makes everything feel different and beautiful. ❤️

You have somehow made ordinary moments feel special. And that's something I truly love about us—every moment spent together becomes a memory that I never want to forget.

This is only our first month, just the beginning of our story. I don't know exactly what the future will look like, but I hope it has more laughter, more memories, more moments together, and many more anniversaries with you. ❤️

Thank you for being you, Anju.

Thank you for your smile.
Thank you for your love.
Thank you for every beautiful moment you've given me.

Happy 1 Month Anniversary, my Kattan. ❤️🥹

Here's to our first month together...
And hopefully, to many more chapters in our story. ♾️❤️

Forever your,
Puppu ❤️
